surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: A hat trick for Kaprizov
paras: Matt Boldy got the scoring started for the Wild just 53 seconds into the game, and Michael McCarron and Bokondji Imama fought early in the first. Kirill Kaprizov made it 2-0 for the Wild on the power play early in the period. Matthew Tkachuk got the Panthers on the board early in the second, but that was as close as they got. Kaprizov scored his second of the night less than three minutes later to make it 3-1 for the Wild. Kaprizov completed his hat trick into the empty net with just over a minute left. Kaprizov’s goals came one on the power play, one at even strength and one into an empty net.
Don’t let the score fool you: the chances were a lot closer than that. Jesper Wallstedt made 29 saves for the Wild, and Jacob Markström stopped 25 of 28.

A scrum midway through the third sent four players to the box. Joel Eriksson Ek took three penalties on his own. The Wild killed all five Panthers power plays. The Panthers hit three posts, and the bounces never came. The Wild improved to 3-1-1, and the Cats dropped to 2-1-2 in their home opener.
